<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents an answer to a specific question and alternative, facilitating data modeling in the system.

Description: The `Answer` class is designed to model the relationship between a question and its possible alternatives. It is instantiated whenever a question-answer pair needs to be represented in the system. The class is used by various services to store and manipulate data related to questions and their answers.

Attributes:
    question_id (int): The ID of the question to which this answer belongs. This attribute is set during initialization and remains immutable throughout the object's lifecycle.
    alternative_id (int): The ID of the alternative answer associated with the question. This attribute is also set during initialization and remains constant.

</DOCSTRING>
